name: Twitch (web)

verifiedAgainst.note: Twitch's Help Center documents no keyboard shortcuts. The player's own 'Keyboard Shortcuts' overlay (S1) and button tooltips (S2) were read from Twitch's production web app, rendered in a throwaway headless Edge profile; extra bindings were read from the same production bundle (S3). Websites change without notice: re-check per player update.

policy.reason: Watching streams in a browser; no game input involved.

any.note: Covers www.twitch.tv and clips.twitch.tv. Reported by the Prism browser extension.
Fallback: Twitch titles are '<Channel> - Twitch' or 'Twitch' (S8); Chrome appends ' - Google Chrome' (S9).
Edge title suffix not observed here; verify with a Twitch tab in Edge.

exclude.note: Creator Dashboard / Stream Manager is a different tool.

contexts.label: Live stream

any.note: Heuristic without the extension: also matches offline channels and category pages.

contexts.verify: On a live channel, check the extension reports media.live = true (durationMs null/Infinity); on an offline channel and on /directory, check it doesn't.

contexts.label: Clip
contexts.verify: Open a clip from a channel's Clips tab and check the URL shape (clips.twitch.tv/<slug> or twitch.tv/<channel>/clip/<slug>).

verbs.label: PLAY/PAUSE

altBindings.note: Twitch's own key (overlay: 'Space/k'); Space only when nothing else has focus (S3).

unavailable.label: NO STREAM
unavailable.hint: No player on this page, or connect the Prism browser extension.

verbs.notes: Overrides the browser pack's verb so K, not the Windows media key, is the lite fallback.

verbs.label: THEATER
verbs.notes: Tooltip 'Theatre Mode (alt+t)' (S2). Esc also leaves theater mode (S3). Alt+T can briefly focus Chrome's toolbar on some setups; Twitch handles the keydown first.

verbs.label: MUTE

unavailable.label: MUTE
unavailable.hint: No player here (clips have no mute key).

verbs.notes: Twitch's M does nothing on clips (S1 omits it there; S3 returns early).

verbs.label: CLIP
verbs.longLabel: Open the clip creator for this stream

unavailable.label: CLIP
unavailable.hint: Log in to Twitch; the channel must allow clips.

verbs.notes: Opens the clip creator overlay; nothing is published until you click Publish (S6). Bound only for logged-in viewers where clipping is allowed (S3).

verbs.label: CHAT
verbs.notes: Bound by the right-column component (S3); listed by S5 as 'Toggles chat side panel'. No true state yet.

verbs.label: BACK 10S

altBindings.note: Also Left. 10 s on VODs, 2 s on clips (S1).

unavailable.label: BACK 10S
unavailable.hint: Past broadcasts and clips only (live streams can't seek).

verbs.notes: On live streams with rewind (DVR) the same keys jump 15 s (S3).

altBindings.note: Twitch uses , / . for speed (YouTube uses them for frames).

verbs.label: CAPTIONS
verbs.longLabel: Captions (toggle, when the stream has them)

unavailable.label: CAPTIONS
unavailable.hint: Only when the broadcaster provides captions.

verbs.verify: On a stream with a CC button, press C and check captions toggle. Only seen in Twitch's bundle (captions button component), not in the overlay or any guide.

verbs.label: SKIP AD
verbs.longLabel: Skip the ad when Twitch offers a skip button

unavailable.label: SKIP AD
unavailable.hint: Only while a skippable ad shows its Skip button.

verbs.verify: During a skippable ad, press G and check the ad skips. Only seen in Twitch's bundle (skip-ad button component binds 'g' once the minimum duration passes).

verbs.label: SHORTCUTS
verbs.notes: Also in the player's Settings menu: 'View Keyboard Shortcuts' (S1).

verbs.label: SEARCH
verbs.verify: Press / on twitch.tv with nothing focused and check the search box takes focus. Listed by S4 only; no '/' binding was found in the bundle (S3).

controls.label: VOLUME
controls.notes: Lite twin of the browser pack's TAB VOL dial (module, 5 %, background).

step.note: 10 s on VODs, 2 s on clips (S1).

userBindings.summary: Twitch's player keys are fixed in the web app; there is no shortcut setting (none in the player menu, S1, or the Help Center, S6). Prism always sends the defaults.

layouts.rationale: Play/CLIP/mute on top (clip is the Twitch moment), theater/chat/full screen in the middle, PiP and the two unverified extras next, back/reload (the usual player fix)/next tab at the bottom; volume left, tabs right.
Same top row plus theater; chat/full screen/PiP/reload below; volume, tabs, scrub (live rewind and VODs) and zoom on the dials.

sources.title: Twitch player 'Keyboard Shortcuts' overlay (Settings > View Keyboard Shortcuts, or ?)
sources.note: Entries: Pause/Play Space/k; Back/Forward 10 s (2 s on clips) Left/Right and j/l, not live; Slow down/Speed up , and ., not live; Change Volume shift+Up/shift+Down; Mute m (not clips); Toggle Fullscreen f; Exit Fullscreen Esc; Show this menu ?. Read from the overlay component in the production bundle.

sources.title: Twitch player button tooltips / aria-labels
sources.note: Rendered DOM (throwaway headless Edge profile, temp dir deleted): 'Play (space/k)', 'Fullscreen (f)', 'Unmute (m)', 'Menu for skipping to content (Alt+P)'. The theater button wasn't rendered on the offline channel used; its label strings 'Theatre Mode (alt+t)' / 'Exit Theatre Mode (alt+t)' come from the same app's bundle (TheatreModeButtonComponent).

sources.title: Twitch production web bundle: Mousetrap key bindings
sources.note: Binds: space/k, shift+up/down (+/-0.1), j/l/left/right (10 s VOD, 2 s clip, 15 s live DVR), m, f, , and . (rate, not live), ?, alt+t and esc (theatre), alt+x (clip, logged in), alt+r (right column), c (captions button), g (skip-ad button).

sources.title: How to Create, Edit, and Share Clips
sources.note: Documents the clip creator (up to 60 s, Publish button) but no keyboard shortcut.

sources.note: Channel page title '<Channel> - Twitch'; video pages /videos/<id>.

sources.title: Read-only probe: Chrome window title suffix ' - Google Chrome'

conflicts: Volume: S4 lists plain Up/Down; Twitch's own overlay (S1) and bundle (S3) use Shift+Up/Shift+Down. The pack follows S1.
Clip key: S5 lists Alt+K for clips on VODs and Alt+X on live; only Alt+X is bound in the current bundle (S3). Alt+K is not used.
Seek: S5 says Left/Right seek the live broadcast by 10 s; S1 hides seeking on live streams, and S3 jumps 15 s only on live streams with rewind (DVR).
gaps: No official Twitch documentation of shortcuts exists; everything rests on the live web app (S1-S3), which can change any day.
Captions (C), skip ad (G) and search (/) are unverified.
Live vs offline channel detection needs the extension (media.live); the title fallback can't tell them apart.
Chat and theater have no true-state readout.
Popout player (player.twitch.tv) and the Stream Manager are not modeled.
notes: Twitch spells it 'Theatre Mode'; the pack uses US spelling on keys (THEATER).
